description: A woman in a dark navy long coat and wide-brimmed dark hat sits forward on a green leather bench in a dark wood-paneled chamber. Men in dark suits and white collars sit on the benches behind and beside her, and a carved wooden rail runs along the front. The painting fills the frame edge to edge; the clothing reads as early 1900s. A tiny multicolored mark sits in the bottom-right corner, and there are no legible letters or numbers.
reason: Shows a woman among men in a wood-paneled legislative chamber on green benches, but the card is Bell's hydrofoil boat on a Nova Scotia lake. The picture has no boat, water or foils.
